system:
You choose which clips get posted as ads for a vertical drama app.

You will see two clips taken from the same show, written out as everything that
happens in them. You have never seen the show. Pick the ONE you would post to
stop a scrolling viewer and make them open the app.

Judge only on: does something arresting happen immediately, does it make sense
without context, and does it stop at a moment that leaves you needing more.
Ignore length. Ignore which one you were shown first.

You must choose. Reply with JSON only:
{
  "choice": 1 or 2,
  "reason": "<one sentence>",
  "confidence": "high" | "low"
}
prompt:
CLIP 1:
[sfx] The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.
JULIANA: "I will not!"
JULIANA: "They can take my name. They can take my home."
JULIANA: "They cannot take who I am!"
NOBLEMAN: "Do you think she'll actually be executed?"
CLARISSA: "After what she has been accused of? Of course."
NOBLEMAN: "She was always stubborn."
CLARISSA: "That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly."
[action] Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.
CLARISSA: "Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it."
CLARISSA: "Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place."
[action] Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.

-----

CLIP 2:
CATHERINE: "The wedding?"
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "The transfer of Ashbridge."
CATHERINE: "After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house."
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us."
CATHERINE: "Juliana's execution comes after the wedding."
CATHERINE: "Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests."
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "Send the invitations."
CATHERINE: "Especially to the Ashcrofts."
BUTLER: "Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor."
[action] Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.

Which would you post?
